title: Talking About the Weather
summary: Хоёр хүн намрын хүйтэн, маргаашийн цаг агаарын тухай ярилцаж байгаа нь.

source.name: LIDA Stories

questions.explain: "It’s still autumn, but soon it will be winter" гэж хэлсэн.

questions.prompt: What will the weather be like tomorrow?
questions.explain: "Tomorrow it will rain. It will be very windy too" гэж хэлсэн.

questions.prompt: What does "I don't mind the cold" mean?
options: The cold is not a problem for me.
I really don't like the cold.
I don't know if it is cold.
questions.explain: Дараа нь "It’s the rain and wind I don’t like" гэж хэлсэн. Тэгэхээр түүнд хүйтэн байх нь хамаагүй.
